key_points: Corning announced a multibillion‑dollar fiber agreement with Verizon, signaling strong demand from AI and broadband markets
Completion of the SDM4 multicore fiber specification positions GLW as a key supplier for high‑density AI data‑center connectivity
Expanded partnership roster with Meta, Amazon, NVIDIA and others enhances long‑term growth narrative
Market reaction shows a 7%+ rally on the news, indicating investor optimism
Dilution concerns are present but appear outweighed by the commercial wins
